---
title: "Homework 6-1"
---

```{r}
library(dbplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
conn <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = 'database.duckdb')
dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
egg_table  <- tbl(conn, 'Bird_eggs')
nest_table <- tbl(conn, 'Bird_nests')
person_table <- tbl(conn, 'Personnel')
```

```{r}
egg_table |> head()
person_table |> head()
nest_table |> head()
```


```{r}
egg_table |> 
    left_join(nest_table, by = 'Nest_ID') |> 
    group_by(Observer) |> 
    summarise(total_eggs = n()) |> 
    left_join(person_table, by = join_by(Observer == Abbreviation)) |> 
    select(Name, total_eggs) |> 
    arrange(desc(total_eggs)) |> 
    head(3) |> show_query()
```

Since I didn't use multiple R statements, `dbplyr` didn't make a temporary table, all was done in one query. At the end of the query, it used a LIMIT 3 clause.

```{r}
dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)
```
